artifact: design-based thicket-condition area estimation with random duplicate selection

random_label_selection.method: independent equal-probability source-label selection for every location with two determinate labels

reference_label_handling.duplicate_determinate_labels: select one submitted source label at random
reference_label_handling.nothicket_treatment: reported as a class (scenario A) or grouped with severe (scenario B)

inputs.adjudication: For every location with two determinate labels, select one submitted source label independently with equal probability using NumPy PCG64 seed 0; unsure labels are ineligible and locations with no determinate label are excluded.

method_notes: Every determinate duplicate location is resolved by reproducible equal-probability random source-label selection, not by map accuracy.
unsure labels are ineligible; locations with no determinate label are excluded.
The Olofsson stratified estimator is used for area and accuracy estimates.
transformed is remapped to severe; no thicket is retained in scenario A and grouped with severe in scenario B.
